status: NEW (audit AU13). Markus said yes on 21 Nov 2026 07:02 Brisbane and set the cap at 1.5x. Everything except the cap is FX-BT1, unchanged.
registered_at: PROPOSED 2026-11-21 (Sat) ~07:15 Brisbane by Claude (Opus 5.5). Version 0 = proving run only (not the record). Registered for the record at the lock (about 12-13 Dec 2026), when LEAGUE_VERSION goes to 1; after that nothing here changes.
hypothesis: FX-BT1 often ends up with all four trades on the same side of the US dollar (17 and 21 Nov). Capping the net exposure to any one currency spreads the four slots across different bets; the question is whether that keeps or improves FX-BT1's result after costs.
rules: Per pair at each close: LONG if close > 100-day average AND 63-day return > 0; SHORT if close < 100-day average AND 63-day return < 0; else FLAT. Exit when the call changes. New entries strongest first by |63-day return| / (ATR14 / close), at most 4 open, each sized so the stop loses 0.5% of equity, total gross at most 2x equity. Code: research_harness/league/forex.py (same order and numbers as kraken-bot/forex_baseline_backtest.py). PLUS: a new entry is cut so that no currency's net exposure (the sum over open trades: a long EUR_USD of size w counts +w EUR and -w USD) passes 1.5x equity; if nothing fits, that pair is skipped and the next strongest is tried.
universe: EUR_USD, USD_JPY, GBP_USD, AUD_USD, USD_CAD, USD_CHF, NZD_USD
rebalance_day: any US session close where an entry, exit or stop happens
stops: 2 x ATR14 from the entry close, fixed at entry. KNOWN DIFFERENCE: the stop is seen when a day's low (long) or high (short) reaches it and the holding is sold at the next open, not at the stop price; entries use the close, not the ask/bid; sizes are kept as shares of equity, so a later decision re-sizes open holdings slightly.
leverage: up to 2x gross (longs plus shorts), forex margin
fills: decided after each US session close (17:15 New York) on OANDA daily mid candles; filled at the next forex day's open (17:00 New York, the instant after the close the rule read).
costs: same shared model as every league line: twins.config.SHARE_COSTS = 0 commission, 2 bps half spread, 3 bps slippage per trade (several times the real major-pair spread: conservative). Overnight financing (interest paid or earned on currency positions) is LEFT OUT, as in the registered FX-BT1 backtest: direction of the bias UNKNOWN.
data_needed: OANDA daily mid candles (500 days) for the 7 pairs
window: forward only: version 1 from the first session after the lock to 31 Dec 2027 (roadmap Phase 2). No backtest stands behind this line in the league.
prior_variants_tried: 1 on this idea (this cap, at the one number Markus chose; no other cap level tried or looked at)
pass_bar: Forex family bar agreed by Markus 20 Nov (AU7, goes into the version 1 files at the lock): return above zero after costs AND above FX-BT1 over the same dates; plus the luck check adjusted for 17 tries (deflated Sharpe, n_trials = 17).
